problem_or_gap: WP301 numerically constrains heterogeneous relevance signals to 0..10000 bp but does not bind producer/scorer/calibration semantics proving that axis magnitudes are commensurate before weighted averaging. Separately, every score_bp > 0 grants a full overlap-axis increment, producing a reproduced zero-to-one-bp discontinuity. WP302 then maps max selected weighted_score_bp to familiarity_bp, so score-semantics ambiguity can propagate into later deterministic attention priority despite aggregate-score integrity checks.

proposed_delta.name: WP301_RETRIEVAL_FUSION_CONTRACT_V2
steps: Introduce a hashed RetrievalSignalWitness binding generator_id/version, score_semantics, scale_id, calibration identity/evidence, producer source revision, query/need snapshot and candidate input identity.
Introduce versioned RetrievalFusionPolicyV2 with explicit fusion_mode, algorithm_version and presence_threshold_bp semantics.
CALIBRATED_SCORE_V1 preserves integer weighted-score fusion only when participating score contracts are explicitly compatible; unknown/incompatible scale/calibration fails closed for score fusion.

ORDINAL_RRF_V1 is an optional deterministic ordering fallback for non-commensurate ranked evidence, with fixed rank_constant/window, deterministic ties, stable evidence-dimension identity and duplicate-dimension rejection.
RRF consensus score is never interpreted as familiarity_bp, probability or truth.
Make overlap support explicit: an axis counts only when its score reaches the versioned policy threshold; threshold identity participates in policy/plan digest.
Preserve v1 replay semantics. Do not silently reinterpret historical v1 plan receipts under v2.
Emit a deterministic RetrievalFusionTrace containing raw per-axis scores/ranks, witness identities, support decisions, fusion parameters, selected order, tie-breaks and trace digest.
Keep hard eligibility gates before soft fusion; no fusion result may resurrect superseded/inadmissible memory.
Keep lexical/vector indexes rebuildable derived structures. Do not add a second truth store or search-server authority.

counterhypotheses: Actual WP301 producers may already share one documented calibrated score contract; if Trigger4 proves this end-to-end, a smaller witness-only delta may be sufficient and ordinal fallback can remain unimplemented.
Pure RRF could avoid cross-scale magnitude assumptions, but it discards magnitude information and must not replace calibrated score semantics needed by WP302 familiarity/abstention.

A mature external search framework could supply fusion operators, but the marginal value is likely negative relative to thin deterministic local control logic and would increase dependency/state/runtime surface.
evidence_refs: OpenSearch hybrid-search score-normalization and RRF current official documentation
upstream_claims_reproduced: Current WP301 formula produces [7000,7000,0] => weighted 4666, overlap 2, rank 9332 and [5000,5000,1] => weighted 3333, overlap 3, rank 9999.
The smallest integer b found for [b,b,1] to outrank [7000,7000,0] under the reproduced equal-weight formula is b=4666, yielding rank 9333.
With explicit support threshold 1000 bp, [5000,5000,1] has overlap 2 and rank 6666, closing this accidental 1-bp breadth bonus.
Naive additive RRF at k=60 doubles a rank-1 contribution from 1/61 to 2/61 if the same evidence dimension is accidentally counted twice.
upstream_claims_not_reproduced: No F2 workload ablation comparing v1 vs v2 vs RRF has been run.
No measured quality improvement on a labeled F2 retrieval corpus exists yet.
No p50/p95/p99 runtime overhead measurement exists yet.
No cross-axis producer calibration audit has yet proven which active WP301 signal generators are actually commensurate.
No sqlite-vec performance or stability benchmark was reproduced for F2.

required_preserved_behaviors: score != truth and memory != observation boundaries

required_tests: All existing WP301 and WP302 tests remain green or are versioned with explicit compatibility rationale.
CALIBRATED_SCORE_V1 rejects numerically same-range axes with incompatible scale/calibration identities.
Signal/candidate/plan digests change when generator/calibration/version identity changes with identical numeric score.
An explicit support threshold closes the reproduced 1-bp overlap inversion for a policy whose meaningful support threshold exceeds 1 bp.
Threshold identity is hashed/versioned and no hidden heuristic threshold exists.
ORDINAL_RRF_V1 is input-order invariant and deterministic under tied ranks.
Same evidence-dimension identity cannot be counted twice in ordinal fusion unless an explicit distinct evidence dimension exists.
Changing RRF rank_constant or rank_window_size changes policy/plan identity.
WP302 cannot consume RRF consensus score as familiarity_bp.
WP302 accepts weighted_score_bp as familiarity only when a familiarity-compatible calibrated score contract is explicit.
Superseded/inadmissible memory remains excluded before both fusion modes.
Deleting/rebuilding any lexical/vector derived index does not mutate canonical UnifiedDB memory facts.
required_ablations: Current v1 formula vs V2 calibrated-score mode on the same deterministic retrieval fixtures.
V2 calibrated-score mode vs ordinal RRF on fixtures where source magnitudes are deliberately transformed monotonically per axis while rank order is preserved.
Per-axis dropout to detect one evidence dimension dominating selection.
Support-threshold sweep using explicitly declared thresholds, reporting stability and false breadth-bonus cases.
Duplicate-dimension injection test for ordinal mode.
WP302 downstream attention-priority comparison with calibrated familiarity vs unavailable rank-only familiarity.
required_measurements: quality/accuracy on an admitted labeled or deterministic oracle retrieval fixture set
prompt/context token delta (expected zero in retrieval core)
cache/reuse behavior if derived FTS/vector generators are integrated
failure behavior under missing/incompatible calibration and stale/mismatched witness identities
expected_token_delta: 0 model tokens in deterministic retrieval core; downstream context may improve or regress only through changed selection and must be measured separately
expected_latency_delta: small positive deterministic metadata/hash/validation overhead, O(candidates*axes); no quantified claim until Trigger4 measures
expected_resource_delta: small witness/trace memory+serialization increase; no network/provider/GPU requirement; exact CPU/RSS delta unmeasured
quality_success_metric: Close the reproduced implicit support-boundary failure; reject incompatible score semantics deterministically; preserve baseline eligible ordering where contracts/thresholds intentionally reproduce v1; prevent rank-only scores from masquerading as familiarity; no regression of provenance/supersession/determinism invariants.
rollback_or_reject_rule: Reject or reduce the candidate if Trigger4 cannot identify a real producer-semantics ambiguity, if v2 creates unacceptable latency/state complexity without measurable evidence benefit, if v1 replay compatibility cannot be preserved, if score/rank types can still cross into WP302 familiarity ambiguously, or if an external dependency becomes required for the core contract. A smaller witness-only patch is preferred if producer audit proves scores already share one valid calibration contract.
known_failure_modes: Schema complexity without real producer diversity.
Mistaking common numeric range for common semantics.
Using RRF fused score as relevance/familiarity magnitude.
Duplicate/correlated evidence dimensions overweighting rank fusion.
Version migration silently changing historical retrieval receipts.
Derived index becoming de facto truth authority.
Fail-open behavior when calibration metadata is absent.
Downstream code treating unknown familiarity as known zero without explicit semantics.
